The Office of Refugee Resettlement stopped funding a network of 100 legal groups after they refused to hand over confidential client data. This leaves 26,000 unaccompanied children without representation in court.

Legal nonprofits are fighting back in court, filing lawsuits to force the government to pay the $65 million owed and protect the integrity of attorney-client privilege.

The government conflates administrative compliance (WHAT) with the ethical duty of legal defense (WHO). By demanding confidential data, they force a structural bait-and-switch that strips children of their legal rights.

Social Physics Analysis:
The administration uses financial leverage as a tool of coercion, creating a pretext of administrative oversight to mask the active dismantling of legal protections. This projection shifts blame onto the lawyers who refuse to compromise their ethics.

The Trajectory: Fall into Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated administrative compliance and the actual stripping of child legal rights, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The systemic closure of legal avenues guarantees harm.

The Unavoidable Truth: Without lawyers, unaccompanied children lose their cases 99% of the time.

The Unavoidable Lie: The contract ended due to a simple administrative disagreement.
